title: The way back up
notes: The Descent's boss: at the Floor of the World the door bursts open, and you race back up the shaft while a blind thing rises after you. Perfects vault you clear.
Real sound effects for everything: stone thuds and cracks, a singing chime for perfects, wet crunches, thunder, ice, a summit swell. Falling slabs splash into the Dark or crumble on the ground.
The music plays your composed tracks again (fixed on iPhone), and the side scenery is smaller and keeps to the corners.
